description: This file defines a partial class for a calculator application's programmer radix operators view, handling UI interactions, state management, and resource loading for bit shift operations within a calculator app.

classes.name: CalculatorProgrammerRadixOperators
classes.description: A partial class representing the UI for programmer radix operations, managing bit shift controls, resource strings, and visual states.

methods.name: CalculatorProgrammerRadixOperators
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view, setting default states, and loading resources.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Property returning the view model associated with this view.

methods.name: IsErrorVisualState
methods.description: Property managing the visual error state of the UI.

methods.name: ParenthesisCountToString
methods.description: Converts a parenthesis count to string, returning empty if zero.

methods.name: checkDefaultBitShift
methods.description: Checks and sets default bit shift buttons visibility and state.

methods.name: BitshiftFlyout_Checked
methods.description: Handles the event when a bit shift mode radio button is checked, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: FlyoutButton_Clicked
methods.description: Handles click event to hide the bitwise flyout.

methods.name: CollapseBitshiftButtons
methods.description: Collapses and disables all bit shift related buttons.

methods.name: LoadResourceStrings
methods.description: Loads resource strings for button labels.

methods.name: LoadDeferredLoadButtons
methods.description: Loads deferred button controls if not already loaded.

methods.name: IsButtonLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the bit shift buttons are loaded.

methods.name: OpenParenthesisButton_GotFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event for the open parenthesis button.

methods.name: ClearEntryButton_LostFocus
methods.description: Handles focus loss for the clear entry button, shifting focus if needed.

methods.name: ClearButton_LostFocus
methods.description: Handles focus loss for the clear button, shifting focus if needed.

methods.name: BitShiftFlyout_Opened
methods.description: Sets the checked state of bit shift mode buttons when the flyout opens.
